# Copilot instructions

Follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) (project rules, stack, commands) and the detailed rules in `.agent/rules/`. Key points: no data leakage (never use `act_*` columns as features; time-based splits), UTC internally/IST in UI, config in `config/*.yaml`, generated API types in the frontend, attribute Open-Meteo (CC BY 4.0), and update `COMPLETION.md` when a roadmap subphase is done.
